author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
## What

Adds the missing `build:<package>` script alias to 8 workspace packages (`types`, `utils`, `error-testing`, `config`, `ui`, `storybook`, `docs`, `moo-dang`), matching the convention already used by `@sparkle/theme` (`"build:theme": "npm run build"`).

## Why

`turbo.json` defines package-qualified task dependencies such as `@sparkle/ui#build:ui` and `@sparkle/config#build:config` for the `test`, `dev`, `docs:automation`, and `build:docs` tasks. Turborepo silently no-ops a dependency edge when the target package has no script matching the task name — it does not error. Only `@sparkle/theme` had defined its `build:theme` alias; every other package listed above only had a generic `build` script, so those dependency edges never actually built anything.

**Concrete symptom**: on a clean checkout (no prior `pnpm build`), `pnpm test`'s `^build:ui` dependency never ran `packages/ui`'s `build:css` step, so `packages/ui/dist/styles.css` was missing. `moo-dang`'s component tests then failed with:

```
Error: Failed to resolve import "./styles.css" from "../../packages/ui/dist/index.js"
```

This wasn't caught by CI because `.github/workflows/main.yaml` only runs `pnpm check` and `pnpm build` — it doesn't run `pnpm test`.

## Fix

Add a `build:<package>` alias (`"npm run build"` / `"pnpm build"`) to each affected package, so the turbo task graph resolves as intended without depending on residual build output from an earlier full `pnpm build`.

## Verification

- Removed all `dist/` and `.turbo/` output across the workspace
- `pnpm test` → 445 passed, 1 skipped (17/17 files), `packages/ui/dist/styles.css` correctly generated via the dependency chain
- `pnpm check` → clean (manypkg, types, turbo config, dependency validation, lint all pass)
- `pnpm build` → all 10 tasks successful
- `pnpm check:monorepo` → workspaces valid
